cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a street food stall at night under a tarp — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; a rocky coast path with tide pools — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a medieval tavern — holds her keepsake at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a sheltered coastal ferry waiting area with coloured glass wind screens — she holds a paper pinwheel against the breeze to pass the wait; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds her keepsake at chest height; a walk-in closet with open shelves — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — reclining on her back; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — standing; the entryway of her home with a shoe bench — sitting on the ground
